# Local interface fonts

Unmodified Inclusive Sans and Krub WOFF2 files, mirrored from the existing Google Fonts CSS API profiles on 2026-10-21. Original style/weight/unicode descriptors are preserved; each page loads its corresponding profile. Identical binaries are stored once. Both families use SIL Open Font License 1.1; retain the included notices. No build or network request is needed at runtime. Source URLs, hashes and byte counts are recorded in sources.json.
